name: Carlos
promptText: Carlos is a short, stocky, elderly man with a slightly oversized head, prominent ears, a bulbous nose and wisps of grey hair, round dark-framed spectacles and a neutral, slightly grumpy expression. He wears a long off-white lab coat (warm white with soft ochre shadows) over a light-grey collared shirt, medium-grey trousers and dark brown leather shoes. Rendered in the same warm painterly style as the 'loma' and 'casa de campo' backgrounds: soft natural daylight, medium contrast, textured brushwork, palette of warm greys, sandy ochres, muted olive greens and soft sky blues, no harsh B&W, subtle canvas texture, detailed fabric folds, consistent anatomy, matching the color temperature and contrast of the forest background recalibrated to loma/casa de campo. Clean, naturalistic, slightly impressionistic, humanized.
